title: incident-bot: integrate SLO Toolkit autodiagnostics into on-call helpers
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Improve on-call runbook suggestions by integrating the SLO Toolkit's automated diagnostics engine into the incident-bot on-call helpers. This enables richer, prioritized runbook recommendations, ties diagnostics to SLO context, and surfaces actionable next steps with telemetry hooks. Changes: 1) incident-bot: new runbook_autodiag module that queries SLO Toolkit diagnostics engine and ranks runbook links by confidence and impact; 2) slo-toolkit: lightweight helpers/api wrapper to expose diagnostics summaries suitable for chat/notification surfaces; 3) telemetry: added oncall diagnostic events and sampling knobs; 4) docs: oncall runbook examples and configuration guide; 5) tests: unit + integration test harness that simulates SLO incidents and verifies suggestion ranking. Checklist: - [x] Design review and Linear spec (ENG-4832) - [x] Implementation of autodiag API wrapper - [x] Unit tests for ranking logic - [x] Integration test with incident-bot mock SLO events - [x] Docs updated with rollout instructions - [x] Feature gated behind runtime flag for gradual rollout Rollout plan: feature gated behind `oncall.autodiag.enabled`; start with 10% canary on internal oncall, monitor suggestion acceptance rate and false positive signal for 72h, then ramp to 50% and full rollout after 7 days if metrics stable. Testing: local unit tests + CI integration job; manual smoke test runbook links in staging Slack channel. Related: ENG-4981 (telemetry hooks) and SUP-1123 (customer-reported missing runbook context). Notes: kept changes non-breaking, provided backward-compatible API for slo-toolkit helpers.

review_comments: Jonah Patel: Nice end-to-end. A few questions: 1) how do we protect PII when summarizing runbooks? 2) can we make confidence thresholds configurable per team?

Ava Martinez: Answered - we redact request-specific tokens and expose an opt-out in the helper; confidence threshold is plumbed through infra/feature_flags and can be overridden per team via the oncall config service.
Rachel Chen: Tests look good but CI integration failed once due to a timing issue. Please add a retry/more deterministic mock for the external diagnostics call.
Ava Martinez: Added a deterministic diagnostics stub and tightened timeouts (see commit g7c9d0f). Re-ran CI; green.
Maya Singh: Approving pending one doc clarification on rollout steps.
Ava Martinez: Clarified rollout steps and added canary monitoring dashboards in docs.
release_notes: Adds incident-bot integration with SLO Toolkit autodiagnostics to surface prioritized on-call runbook suggestions. Feature is gated and rolled out gradually. Includes telemetry events for monitoring suggestion quality.
notes_for_reviewer: Primary area to review is the ranking heuristic in runbook_autodiag.py and the privacy redaction logic. The rest are wrappers and docs. The feature is behind a flag so we can rollback quickly if needed.
